headline: Port St. Lucie City Manager Releases Proposed FY 2026-27 Budget
body:
Port St. Lucie City Manager Jesus Merejo has released his proposed budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

According to the city, the proposed budget supports Port St. Lucie's strategic goal of maintaining a high-performing government organization.

Residents can review the proposed budget at cityofpsl.com/budget.

The Port St. Lucie City Council is scheduled to review the proposed budget during a workshop on July 22 and July 23 at the Community Center, located at 2195 SE Airoso Blvd.

The workshop will also be televised live on the city's website, Xfinity Channel 20, and Blue Stream Fiber Channel 20.
